[P3] Return the new flush mechanism to the design phase

Rules 2, “Simplify before you add,” and 3, “Write a design note before the code,” require alternatives and their rejection reasons before adding this feature. The description summarizes daemon workers, provider admission, and a fixed deadline, but does not explain the separate flushing problem and cause or evaluate simpler options. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and obtain agreement on a note comparing provider-managed timeouts with this additional lifecycle mechanism before continuing implementation.
